subject: Operations
title: Hofstede's Cultural Dimensions
description: A micro-lesson that makes Hofstede's Cultural Dimensions usable.

hook.text: In some cultures, questioning your boss is brave. In others, it's career suicide. Hofstede measured these differences.

buildup.text: Geert Hofstede studied IBM employees across 70 countries and identified six dimensions of national culture.

discovery.text: Dimensions include power distance, individualism, uncertainty avoidance, masculinity, long-term focus, and indulgence.

twist.text: High power distance cultures accept hierarchy. Low power distance cultures expect equality. Managing both is tricky.

climax.text: Operations managers use Hofstede's framework to adapt leadership, communication, and decision-making styles by country.

punchline.text: Culture shapes how people work. Understand it or clash with it.
